types.name: Podcast
types.input: Complete host-labelled spoken script and delivery directions; music only when requested.

types.name: Ambient sound
types.input: A sustained sound environment, foreground/background sources, distance and changes.

types.name: Sound effects
types.input: Sound source, action, material, texture, timing and decay.

types.name: Dialogue
types.input: Stable speaker labels, exact lines and outside-the-lines performance directions.

types.name: AI music
types.input: Instrumental music: style, mood, instruments, rhythm, development and ending; no singing or lyrics.

types.name: Song
types.input: Original vocal song: genre, singing/rap delivery, instruments, section order and exact lyrics to sing.

types.name: Game sound effects
types.input: Game action and sound progression. Single clips through CLI; batch, variants and selected ZIP through the website.

types.name: Narration
types.input: Exact narration text and necessary delivery directions.

types.name: Sound scene
types.nameZh: 广告、广播剧与声音场景
types.input: Exact speech and requested effects, ambience or music in listening order.

types.name: Character voice design
types.input: Voice description and short preview text; create and preview reusable references with the CLI. Catalog import uses the website.
